title: Our elder brothers: Judaism, the Jewish roots of the faith, and the Church
tagline: Learn the Jewish roots of Christian faith, listen to Jewish voices, and understand what the Church teaches and repents of.
whyItMatters: Jesus, Mary and the apostles were Jewish, and the Church says she is tied to the Jewish people. Knowing this root deepens the Mass, the Bible and our respect for Jewish neighbours.

mindset.tip: Begin with respect and with the Church's own words: the Jews remain beloved by God for the sake of the fathers (Romans 11:28-29; Nostra Aetate 4; CCC 839-840).
Never blame Jews today or in general for the death of Christ. The Church teaches this plainly (Nostra Aetate 4; CCC 597-598).
Let Jews speak for themselves. Read Jewish sources before describing Jewish belief.
Speak of fulfilment, not replacement, and avoid caricatures of "the Law" or "the Pharisees".
Be ready to say honestly that the Church has failed Jews in the past, and to listen to their pain.
